title: Spinning Silver
author: Naomi Novik
summary: A moneylender's daughter in a cold, fairy-tale kingdom takes over her family's failing business and becomes known for turning silver into gold. A winter king hears of it and makes her an impossible demand.
readIf: you like a smart, slow-building fairy tale with several viewpoints and a quiet, practical heroine.
skipIf: you want a quick, single-voice story, since it moves between several narrators.

pairings.reason: Same author and the same rich fairy-tale atmosphere with a more romantic, magical lead.
Another wintry, folklore-heavy fantasy with a determined girl standing against old powers.
Another retelling in which a woman turns being underestimated into power.
